title: esdra sessilis
intro: Esdra sessilis, commonly known as Marsh Cress or Yellow Rattle, is a small, annual plant belonging to the balsam family (Impatiens). It is native to wetlands and marshy areas in Europe and Asia. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the treatment of respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Esdra sessilis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
